summary: Final production verification against https://irish-whiskey-booking.fly.dev. Backend auth, shared-room bookings, pairing, and unpair all work on production. Homepage (Castlerosse Park Resort in Killarney) and admin dashboard UI including Zimmerpartner page render correctly. Two production blockers found: (1) invoice email on production returns partial_success with message that EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY is not working, (2) frontend/.env still points to the preview backend URL, not the Fly.io production backend, so the deployed frontend will not actually hit production.
passed: GET /api/ on fly.io returns 200 with correct API title
POST /api/admin/login returns JWT token with info@travel-events.de credentials
POST /api/bookings creates shared-room bookings (created TestA SharedA + TestB SharedB)
POST /api/admin/pair-roommates with {booking_ids:[a,b]} pairs both bookings (roommate_id set bidirectionally)
Admin login UI works and redirects to /admin
Zimmerpartner UI page loads shared bookings via hbh_admin_token (no auth error)

failed.issue: POST /api/admin/bookings/{id}/send-invoice returns status 'partial_success' with message: 'PDF generated successfully but email could not be sent. Please check EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY configuration.'
failed.evidence: curl against https://irish-whiskey-booking.fly.dev with booking 01c62314-188b-425a-97a6-8e7d2c931fa5 returned HTTP 200 but partial_success. Fly.io deployment may be missing EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY env var or key is invalid in prod.

failed.issue: frontend/.env still has REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://hbh-booking-hub.preview.emergentagent.com instead of the Fly.io production URL
failed.evidence: cat /app/frontend/.env shows preview URL. The frontend UI tested therefore runs against the preview backend, not production. Needs to be updated to https://irish-whiskey-booking.fly.dev before frontend redeploy.

action_items: Set EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY as a secret on Fly.io app (fly secrets set EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY=ek_cf7e58eaf25f0e15b02dca42576e6784) and redeploy, then retest POST /api/admin/bookings/{id}/send-invoice
Update /app/frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to https://irish-whiskey-booking.fly.dev and redeploy the frontend so UI uses production backend
Verify unpair endpoint path in RoommatePairing.js matches backend (/api/admin/unpair-roommate singular, not plural)
